question: In April 2020, UB Pravin Rao, Chief Operating Officer of ______, was appointed Chairman of NASSCOM.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Infosys**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After Salil Parekh was named **CEO and MD of Infosys** on December 2, 2017, **U. B. Pravin Rao** was named chief operating officer.
 
• He was previously named interim CEO and MD after Vishal Sikka stepped down.
 
• He is a member of the Confederation of Indian Industry's (CII) National Council and Nasscom's Executive Council.
 
• In the **fiscal year 2020-2021**, he will serve as chairman of NASSCOM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Infosys Limited** is an Indian multinational IT corporation that specializes in business consulting, information technology, and outsourcing.
 
• The company is located in Bangalore and was formed in Pune.
 
• By 2020 sales projections, Infosys is the second-biggest Indian IT business, behind Tata Consultancy Services, and the 602nd largest public company in the world, according to the Forbes Global 2000 list.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wipro Limited **is an Indian multinational organization that specializes in IT, consulting, and business process outsourcing.
 
• **HCL Technologies**, headquartered in **Noida**, is an Indian multinational information technology services and consulting firm.
 
• **Tata Consultancy Services** is a **Mumbai**-based Indian multinational information technology services and consulting firm.
